page.layout: One printed title page, text upside down on the scan. Large title at the top, then smaller lines of title text in the centre, a short block in the middle, a few lines lower down, and an imprint line with a date at the foot. No margins with text. A library stamp at the bottom right is omitted.
page.notes: The whole page is printed upside down and is very faint and blurred. Mirrored text from the reverse side shows through, so most lines cannot be separated from it. Only the large title "AD ... Romanos" can be made out with any confidence, and its first word is doubtful. The lower lines and the date line at the foot could not be read letter by letter. The rotated scan may give a clearer reading if it is turned 180 degrees. A library stamp ("Stadt Bibliothek Regensburg") is not transcribed, as it is not printed text.
